newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon prime minister Hariri goes to Russia.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon prime minister Hariri goes to Russia.

text.p: Lebanese Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri left Beirut on Monday for a two-day visit to Moscow -- the first official visit by a Lebanese premier to Russia.
Official sources said Hariri, who is scheduled to meet President Boris Yeltsin on Tuesday, will discuss how to get Russia more involved in the Middle East peace process.
A ministerial delegation accompanying Hariri will also hold talks on boosting bilateral economic ties.
On Wednesday, Hariri will leave Moscow for Paris on his way to Canada for another official visit.
